desc.cn: 都认真点，教授要传授工业知识了！
desc.en: Focus! The professor is going to lay down some serious factory know-how!

desc.cn: 攻击力：<@ba.key>981 攻击间隔：<@ba.key>3秒 攻击方式：以抛物线发射榴弹攻击敌人，榴弹会在敌人附近地面爆炸并造成范围<@ba.fire>灼热伤害。
desc.en: ATK: <@ba.key>981 Attack Interval: <@ba.key>3s Mode of Attack: Launches grenades in a ballistic trajectory. The grenades detonate above ground near enemies and deal area of effect <@ba.fire>Heat DMG.

desc.cn: 攻击力：<@ba.key>5585 攻击间隔：<@ba.key>3秒 攻击方式：以抛物线发射Ⅱ级榴弹攻击敌人，榴弹会在敌人附近地面爆炸并造成范围<@ba.fire>灼热伤害，同时在地面留下一片燃烧区域对敌人造成伤害。
desc.en: ATK: <@ba.key>5585 Attack Interval: <@ba.key>3s Mode of Attack: Attacks enemies by launching Mk Ⅱ grenades along a ballistic trajectory that detonate above ground near enemies. The grenade explosion deals area of effect <@ba.fire>Heat DMG and leaves a burning zone that deals DMG to enemies within it.

desc.cn: 攻击力：<@ba.key>12375 攻击间隔：<@ba.key>5秒 攻击方式：发射特制酸液弹，酸液弹会在敌人附近地面爆炸并造成范围<@ba.natur>自然伤害，同时降低范围内敌人的防御力。
desc.en: ATK: <@ba.key>12375 Attack Interval: <@ba.key>5s Mode of Attack: Launches special acid grenades that detonate above ground near enemies to deal <@ba.natur>Nature DMG and apply DEF Reduction to enemies in the area of effect.

desc.cn: 攻击力：<@ba.key>5485 攻击间隔：<@ba.key>5秒 攻击方式：发射特制毒雾弹，毒雾弹会在敌人附近地面爆炸并留下一片毒雾区，对范围内的敌人造成持续<@ba.natur>自然伤害与减速效果。
desc.en: ATK: <@ba.key>5485 Attack Interval: <@ba.key>5s Mode of Attack: Launches special mist grenades that detonate above ground near enemies. The mist grenade explosion deals <@ba.natur>Nature DMG over time and applies slow to enemies within the area of effect.

desc.cn: 攻击间隔：<@ba.key>5秒 攻击方式：发射特殊液氮晶体，晶体爆裂后会降低范围内敌人的移动速度。
desc.en: Attack Interval: <@ba.key>5s Mode of Attack: Fires special liquid nitrogen (LN) crystals that shatter upon impact to slow the movement speed of enemies in the area of effect.

desc.cn: 攻击间隔：<@ba.key>5秒 攻击方式：当敌人靠近时，发射一道激流，激流会使中型及小型敌人向攻击方向后退。
desc.en: Attack Interval: <@ba.key>5s Mode of Attack: Fires a stream of deluge at approaching enemies. The stream pushes back small and medium enemies along the direction of the attack.

desc.cn: 攻击力：<@ba.key>22338 攻击间隔：<@ba.key>8秒 攻击方式：消耗大量充能向目标发射射线，对敌人造成高额<@ba.pulse>电磁伤害。
desc.en: ATK: <@ba.key>22338 Attack Interval: <@ba.key>8s Mode of Attack: Consumes vast amounts of energy to emit a beam that deals massive <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG to enemies.

desc.cn: 攻击力：<@ba.key>45375 攻击间隔：<@ba.key>8秒 攻击方式：消耗大量充能向目标发射强力射线，优先锁定范围内威胁更高的敌人，对敌人造成高额<@ba.pulse>电磁伤害。
desc.en: ATK: <@ba.key>45375 Attack Interval: <@ba.key>8s Mode of Attack: Consumes vast amounts of energy to emit a powerful beam to deal massive <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG to enemies. This tower prioritizes its attacks at high threat targets within range.

desc.cn: 攻击力：<@ba.key>4886 攻击间隔：<@ba.key>3秒 攻击方式：释放电能攻击敌人，攻击会弹射到附近敌人（至多2次），造成<@ba.pulse>电磁伤害。
desc.en: ATK: <@ba.key>4886 Attack Interval: <@ba.key>3s Mode of Attack: Releases electrical arcs that attack enemies. The arc also chains to nearby enemies (up to 2) and deals <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG.

desc.cn: 最小治疗间隔：<@ba.key>5秒 可将充能转化为治疗量，治疗周围受伤的干员。
desc.en: Minimum HP Treatment Interval: <@ba.key>5s Converts electrical power into healing arts that can treat injured operators nearby.

desc.cn: 攻击力：<@ba.key>33000 攻击间隔：<@ba.key>8秒 攻击方式：消耗大量充能向目标发射威力极大的炮弹，对范围内敌人造成高额<@ba.phy>物理伤害。
desc.en: ATK: <@ba.key>33000 Attack Interval: <@ba.key>8s Mode of Attack: Consumes vast amounts of energy to fire an extremely powerful shell. The shell deals massive <@ba.phy>Physical DMG to enemies in the area of effect.

desc.cn: 攻击间隔：<@ba.key>5秒 攻击方式：发射一道震荡波，对范围内的普通敌人和进阶敌人施加<@ba.vdown>晕眩效果。
desc.en: Attack Interval: <@ba.key>5s Mode of Attack: Fires a shockwave that <@ba.vdown>stuns common and advanced enemies within the area of effect.

desc.cn: 攻击力：<@ba.key>11634 攻击间隔：<@ba.key>5秒 攻击方式：拥有较大攻击范围，优先锁定范围内威胁更高的敌人，对敌人造成高额<@ba.phy>物理伤害。
desc.en: ATK: <@ba.key>11634 Attack Interval: <@ba.key>5s Mode of Attack: Unleashes long-range attacks that target high-threat enemies first and deal massive <@ba.phy>Physical DMG.

desc.cn: 攻击力：<@ba.key>17252 攻击方式：当敌人靠近时，喷射火焰攻击敌人，对范围内的敌人持续造成<@ba.fire>灼热伤害。
desc.en: ATK: <@ba.key>17252 Mode of Attack: Fires a flaming jet to attack approaching enemies. The flaming jet deals <@ba.fire>Heat DMG over time to enemies within range.

desc.cn: 攻击力：<@ba.key>609 攻击间隔：<@ba.key>2秒 攻击方式：持续发射能量弹，对敌人造成<@ba.phy>物理伤害。
desc.en: ATK: <@ba.key>609 Attack Interval: <@ba.key>2s Mode of Attack: Continuously fires energy bolts that deal <@ba.phy>Physical DMG.

desc.cn: 攻击力：<@ba.key>2136 攻击间隔：<@ba.key>2秒 攻击方式：持续发射Ⅱ级能量弹，每第4次攻击会发射一次强力能量弹，对敌人造成<@ba.phy>物理伤害。
desc.en: ATK: <@ba.key>2136 Attack Interval: <@ba.key>2s Mode of Attack: Continuously fires Mk II energy bolts with every 4th shot being an empowered bolt. The bolts deal <@ba.phy>Physical DMG.

desc.cn: 用于便捷存取仓库物品的设备。
desc.en: A facility that allows quick access of items in the Depot.

desc.cn: 绝大部分游商最喜欢购入的商品。可装饰于商场、住宅等多种场景的龙泡泡气球，就在此处。
desc.en: A favorite purchase of almost every traveling merchant. This is the very place where you can get Chubby Lung Balloons for decorating all sorts of places, from shopping malls to private residences.

desc.cn:
“从入库单上判断，这应该是额外定制的工艺品……”
“你确定这不是直接从武陵街头搬回来的吗？”
desc.en:
"According to our inventory, these are pieces of public art made to custom specifications..." 
"Are you sure we didn't just nick them from the streets of Wuling?"

desc.cn: 能够加工各式零件的平台。
desc.en: A facility capable of processing various parts and components.

desc.cn: 用于进行物理分拆的设备。
desc.en: A facility that physically separates various items.

desc.cn: 用于供给液体的设备。
desc.en: A facility for dispensing fluids.

desc.cn: 用于供给液体的设备。
desc.en: A facility for dispensing fluids.

desc.cn: 能够将原料灌装到容器的设备。
desc.en: A facility capable of filling containers with various materials.

desc.cn: 使用高温精炼其他材料的设备。
desc.en: A facility that performs high temperature refining of various materials.

desc.cn: 使用高温精炼其他材料的设备。
desc.en: A facility that performs high temperature refining of various materials.

desc.cn: 能粉碎各种材料的重型设备。
desc.en: A heavy facility that shreds and pulverizes various materials.

desc.cn: 虎牢于此。
desc.en: A rakerbeast has been secured here.

desc.cn: 武陵净水节点的污水处理接入口，可在此端口通入污水，进行高效污水处理。
desc.en: An inlet of the Wuling Purification Node. Connect a Sewage pipeline to it for some high performance water treatment.

desc.cn: 用于处理污水的设备，也可低效处理壤晶废液与惰性壤晶废液。
desc.en: A facility for processing Sewage. It can also process Xircon Effluent and Inert Xircon Effluent, albeit with limited efficiency.

desc.cn: 用于将溶液提纯至更高纯度溶液的设备。
desc.en: A facility for raising the purity of various solutions.

desc.cn: 武陵净水节点的产物排出口，可在此端口获取污水处理产物——壤晶废液。
desc.en: A byproduct outlet of the Wuling Purification Node. It can dispense a Sewage treatment byproduct known as Xircon Effluent.

desc.cn: 存储液体的设备。
desc.en: A facility for storing fluids.

desc.cn: 存储液体的设备。
desc.en: A facility for storing fluids.

desc.cn: 可将物品运送至当地仓库的活动端口，只能贴靠仓库存取线放置。
desc.en: A placeable loading point that delivers goods from the AIC Factory to a local depot. The Depot Loader must be placed right next to the Depot Bus.

desc.cn: 可以在集成核心区域放置的仓库存取线基段，需要和仓库存取线源桩或其他生效的仓库存取线基段相连，其上可贴靠仓库存货口和仓库取货口。
desc.en: A bus section that can be deployed in the Core AIC Area. The Depot Bus Section must be connected to a Depot Bus Port or other active Depot Bus Sections. Once active, Depot Loaders and Depot Unloaders can be attached to the Depot Bus.

desc.cn: 作为仓库存取线的起始点，可以在集成核心区域自由放置。
desc.en: The origin of the Depot Bus. The Depot Bus Port can be placed anywhere in the Core AIC Area.

desc.cn: 用于留下标记信息的设备。
desc.en: A facility that can be used to post and leave beacon memos.

desc.cn: 用来开采源矿的机械设备，可使用源石完成自供能，不需要通电就可以运作。
desc.en: A mining rig for digging up Originium Ore. This rig does not need to be connected to the power grid to work as it powers itself using the Originium it mines.

desc.cn: 在通电状态下，可以用来开采源矿、紫晶矿的机械设备。
desc.en: Requires power. This mining rig can mine Originium Ore and Amethyst Ore.

desc.cn: 在通电状态下，可以用来开采蓝铁矿等多种矿物的机械设备。
desc.en: Requires power. This mining rig can mine Ferrium Ore and other minerals.

desc.cn: 用来开采赤铜矿等多种矿物的机械设备，可使用清水完成自供能，不需要通电就可以运作。
desc.en: A mining rig for digging up various types of ore such as Cuprium Ore. This rig does not need power as it can be driven with Clean Water.

desc.cn: 进行固液体化学反应的设备。
desc.en: A facility for running solid or liquid-state chemical reactions.

desc.cn: 进行固液体化学反应的设备，拥有更多的端口并可同时进行更多的化学反应。
desc.en: A facility for running solid or liquid-state chemical reactions. It also comes with additional input and output ports and the ability to run multiple reactions simultaneously.

desc.cn: 景存知春盛，人杳非此时。
desc.en: Verdant spring wakes upon the enduring land, yet friends have gone and times have changed.

desc.cn: 能够培育各类普通植物的仓形设备。
desc.en: A silo for growing various common plants and crops.

desc.cn:
通电后可给较大范围内的终末地设备无线供电。
完成后续工业计划研发后可进行30m内短距离电力运输。
desc.en: Once connected to the power grid, this pylon can wirelessly power all Endfield facilities within a sizable area. Researching certain AIC Factory Plan technologies also gives this facility a 30-meter power transmission capability.

desc.cn: 可自动连接协议核心与息壤中继器（80m内）、息壤供电桩以及其他电力设备（30m内）。在集成核心区域内可无视距离限制自动连接协议核心。可进行范围供电与短距离电力传输。
desc.en: Xiranite Pylons can auto-connect to the Protocol Automation-Core (PAC) and Xiranite Relays within 80 meters; and to Xiranite Pylons and other power facilities within 30 meters. When placed inside the Core AIC Area, they can auto-connect to the PAC regardless of distance. Xiranite Pylons can be used to supply power to facilities within range and transmit power across short distances.

desc.cn:
可以在80m范围内完成电力配给的中继设备，只能进行电力传输。
完成后续工业计划研发后可给小范围内的终末地设备无线供电。
desc.en: This relay can be used to transmit power to other facilities within an 80-meter radius. Researching certain AIC Factory Plan technologies also lets this facility wirelessly supply power to other Endfield facilities within a small area.

desc.cn: 可自动连接协议核心与全部息壤电力设备（80m内）。在集成核心区域内可无视距离限制自动连接协议核心。可进行电力传输与小范围供电。
desc.en: Xiranite Relays can auto-connect to the Protocol Automation-Core (PAC) and any type of Xiranite power facilities within 80 meters. When placed inside the Core AIC Area, they can auto-connect to the PAC regardless of distance. Xiranite Relays can be used for power transmission and can supply power to nearby facilities.

desc.cn: 作为电路末端的终端设备，可接入电网为其他场所供电。
desc.en: Electric Nexuses are usually placed at the end of power transmission lines. Connect them to the power grid to supply power to nearby facilities.

desc.cn: 利用源矿或电池提供电能的设备，只有接入电网才能生效。
desc.en: A facility that converts Originium Ore or batteries into electrical power. It must be connected to the power grid to work.

desc.cn: 在通电状态下，用于抽取液体的设备。
desc.en: Requires power. A facility for pumping fluids.

desc.cn: 在通电状态下，用于抽取液体的设备，可以进行腐蚀性液体的抽取。
desc.en: Requires power. A facility for pumping fluids. It is also capable of pumping corrosive liquids.

desc.cn: 能够采集普通植物种子的设备。
desc.en: A facility that extracts seeds from common crops.

desc.cn: 能够冲压各种容器的设备。
desc.en: A facility that produces various containers via stamp moulding.

desc.cn: 终末地的技术核心，一种大型能量利用设备组。
desc.en: The core of the Endfield AIC technology. It serves as the nexus of the AIC and its power grid.

desc.cn: 终末地技术核心的子版本，与母版本基本一致。
desc.en: A smaller version of the Endfield technological nexus. It works like the original Automation-Core.

desc.cn: 向固定位置喷洒液体的设备。
desc.en: A facility that sprays fluids in a fixed direction.

desc.cn: 向固定位置喷洒液体的设备。
desc.en: A facility that sprays fluids in a fixed direction.

desc.cn: 拥有多个容纳格的储物设备，由于在通电状态下可将其中物品转移至仓库，因此多用于产线末端。
desc.en: A storage facility with several item storage slots. Once connected to the power grid and given enough power, it can teleport items to the Depot. Hence, the stash is often placed at the end of production lines.

desc.cn: 拥有多个容纳格的储物设备，由于在通电状态下可将其中物品转移至仓库，因此多用于产线末端。
desc.en: A storage facility with several item storage slots. Once connected to the power grid and given enough power, it can teleport items to the Depot. Hence, the stash is often placed at the end of production lines.

desc.cn: 可以对粉末材料进行细致研磨处理的设备。
desc.en: A facility that performs fine grinding of powdered materials.

desc.cn: 用于封装部分能量元件的设备。
desc.en: A facility for packaging certain power components.

desc.cn: 可在80m范围内相连，架起索道的小型设备。
desc.en: A small zipline facility that can be connected to another zipline facility within an 80-meter radius to create a zipline.

desc.cn: 可在110m范围内相连，架起索道的大型设备。
desc.en: A large zipline facility that can be connected to another zipline facility within a 110-meter radius to create a zipline.

desc.cn: 可在80m范围内相连，架起索道的小型设备。
desc.en: A small zipline facility that can be connected to another zipline facility within an 80-meter radius to create a zipline.

desc.cn: 地下暗管的入口，可与暗管出口进行配对连接，传输管道中的货物。
desc.en: An inlet for an underground pipeline. Connect this to a matching Conduit Outlet to transport fluids through it.

desc.cn: 地下暗管的大型入口，可与多口暗管出口进行配对连接，传输管道中的货物。
desc.en: A large inlet facility for an underground pipeline. Connect this to a matching Conduit Outlet Manifold to transport fluids through it.

desc.cn: 地下暗管的出口，可与暗管入口进行配对连接，传输管道中的货物。
desc.en: An outlet for an underground pipeline. Connect this to a matching Conduit inlet to transport fluids through it.

desc.cn: 地下暗管的大型出口，可与多口暗管入口进行配对连接，传输管道中的货物。
desc.en: A large outlet facility for an underground pipeline. Connect this to a matching Conduit Inlet Manifold to transport fluids through it.

desc.cn: 可选择物品从当地仓库取出的活动端口，只能贴靠仓库存取线放置。
desc.en: A placeable unloading point that transfers goods from a local depot into the AIC Factory. The Depot Unloader must be placed right next to the Depot Bus.

desc.cn: 能够将不同材料嵌合加工成装备原件的设备。
desc.en: A facility that laminates different materials together to create gear components.

desc.cn: 用于息壤相关产物合成的设备。
desc.en: A facility for making Xiranite-based products.
